feed.title: Greek News Aggregator — Kathimerini Daily Digest
feed.subtitle: Top 20 stories by importance

entry.title: Eπιχείρηση «Odin»: Τι αναφέρει η ΕΛ.ΑΣ. για τη σύλληψη του 37χρονου – Φωτογραφίες από το σπίτι στα Πατήσια
entry.summary: The "Odin" operation by the intelligence service and the counter-terrorism unit led to the arrest of a 37-year-old in Agios Nikolaos, Crete, who had ordered chemicals online to build explosives. The suspect confessed to being a Hamas member planning a mass attack.

entry.title: Κυρ. Μητσοτάκης για Συνταγματική Αναθεώρηση: «Τολμηρές αλλά αναγκαίες οι αλλαγές»
entry.summary: In his weekly review PM Kyriakos Mitsotakis called the constitutional-revision changes "bold but necessary," framing a vision of Greece in 2030. He proposes non-state universities, reform of ministerial liability, linking civil-service tenure to evaluation, and constitutional protection of affordable housing.

entry.title: Σεισμοί στην Εύβοια: Κλειστά αύριο τα σχολεία στο Μαντούδι – Κανονικά οι Πανελλήνιες
entry.summary: Two strong earthquakes around 1 p.m. Sunday centered on northern Euboea were also felt in Attica. Primary schools in the Mantoudi municipality will stay shut Monday as a precaution, while the national university exams proceed as scheduled.

entry.title: ΣΥΡΙΖΑ: Υπερψηφίστηκε η πρόταση Φάμελλου – «Δίπλα» στην πρωτοβουλία Τσίπρα
entry.summary: SYRIZA's central committee approved Socrates Famellos's motion to align with Alexis Tsipras's new movement, without a roll-call vote. The leadership claims about 70% support, while Pavlos Polakis insists his rival proposal drew over 40%.

entry.title: Από ρύθμιση σε ρύθμιση τα ίδια χρέη
entry.summary: Total overdue debts to the tax authority and social-security funds reach €165 billion, but only an estimated €27 billion is realistically collectible. The government is preparing a new 72-installment scheme, though analysts warn expectations of mass uptake are overly optimistic.

entry.title: Κρήτη: Η εκπαίδευση στη Μαλαισία και οι online παραγγελίες χημικών – Η ομολογία του 37χρονου της Χαμάς
entry.summary: New details on the 37-year-old arrested in Agios Nikolaos, Crete, point to training in Malaysia and online orders of chemicals. He confessed to being a Hamas member with contacts among those arrested in Cyprus, though he had not yet built a bomb.

entry.title: Ανταλλαγή επιθέσεων μεταξύ Ισραήλ και Λιβάνου – Νεκροί πέντε στρατιώτες
entry.summary: Israeli-Lebanese exchanges of fire continued despite a deal announced in Washington, with an Israeli strike killing three Lebanese soldiers and two deaths reported in Israeli ranks. President Aoun condemned the "flagrant violation" of sovereignty.

entry.title: Γαλλία και Κύπρος υπογράφουν συμφωνία για ανάπτυξη γαλλικών δυνάμεων στο νησί
entry.summary: France and Cyprus will sign a Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA) on Monday allowing Paris to station and operate troops on the island. The deal is to be signed in Nicosia with full respect for national sovereignty.

entry.title: Ελληνικά drones θα δοκιμάσει ο στρατός
entry.summary: Drone systems from 11 Greek firms selected by the defense-innovation center ELKAK will be tested June 8-11 in the "Trojan Horse 2026" exercise across Thrace, the Peloponnese and the Ionian. Athens is also buying ten VICTA underwater vehicles worth €145 million.

entry.title: Παραβιάζει την εργατική νομοθεσία το 25% των επιχειρήσεων
entry.summary: Labor Inspectorate data for 2025 show 25% of businesses violate labor law, dominated by undeclared work and unpaid wages. Of 82,233 inspections, 19,093 sanctions, over 2,500 lawsuits and €54 million in fines resulted.

entry.title: Τραμπ: «Οχι» σε αποδέσμευση ιρανικών κεφαλαίων πριν τη συμφωνία
entry.summary: Donald Trump ruled out releasing "frozen" Iranian assets or lifting sanctions before a peace deal with Tehran. The statement comes as a military adviser to Iran's supreme leader links any agreement to the release of those funds.

entry.title: Νέοι ισραηλινοί βομβαρδισμοί στη Γάζα – Τουλάχιστον εννέα νεκροί
entry.summary: Fresh Israeli strikes on the Gaza Strip killed at least nine people despite the October 2025 ceasefire. A drone strike killed seven in a displacement camp, while the Israeli military says it killed a Hamas commander.

entry.title: Χορός με τη σκιά τους
entry.summary: PASOK is trying to escape a slump in the polls by unveiling a shadow cabinet, recalled cadres and new recruits. Leader Nikos Androulakis is betting on its programme and bench of officials, even as talk of post-election alliances resurfaces.

entry.title: Σεισμικές δονήσεις στη Βόρεια Εύβοια – «Η περιοχή δεν δίνει μεγέθη πάνω από 5,5 Ρίχτερ»
entry.summary: Seismologists, including OASP head Efthymios Lekkas, struck a reassuring tone over the northern Euboea quakes, noting the area does not produce magnitudes above 5.5. The first strong 4.8 tremor caused damage to old houses and landslides.

entry.title: Ενας νεκρός και πέντε τραυματίες από επίθεση με όπλο στο κεντρικό Ισραήλ
entry.summary: One person was killed and five wounded by gunfire in central Israel on Sunday, in an attack treated as terrorism. According to Reuters the shootings occurred in three areas near Qalqilya, with the assailant "neutralized."

entry.title: Σε αυξημένη ετοιμότητα η Πυροσβεστική σε Αττική και Εύβοια μετά τους σεισμούς
entry.summary: The fire service went on heightened alert in Attica and Euboea after successive quakes of 4.8, 4.3 and 5.2 on the Richter scale. A collapsed wall, cracks in homes and minor road landslides were recorded, with the civil-protection minister in constant contact.

entry.title: Σεισμοί στην Εύβοια: Κατολισθήσεις και ζημιές σε οδικό δίκτυο, σπίτια και μαγαζιά
entry.summary: The Euboea quakes caused extensive road damage from landslides as well as damage to homes, buildings and shops. The Mantoudi mayor reported no injuries, though anxiety prevails among residents.

entry.title: Το real estate του Ράμα
entry.summary: Kathimerini maps Albania's 35-year feud over property restitution and PM Edi Rama's geopolitical maneuvering, tracing it to the 1991 law 7501 on land distribution. The Greek minority, and especially Himara, appears disadvantaged by the ownership regime.

entry.title: Επιχείρηση διάσωσης 61 μεταναστών στην Κρήτη
entry.summary: Two rescue operations south of Crete, coordinated by the national search-and-rescue center, picked up 61 migrants from two boats. The survivors were taken to Paleochora for reception and registration procedures.

entry.title: Ρωγμές στον άξονα Μπίμπι – Τραμπ
entry.summary: Vassilis Kostoulas examines the cracks in the Netanyahu-Trump axis as both leaders enter election season and the Iran impasse drags on. The US-Israel alliance, which had reached a historic high, is being tested.
